summary: Comprehensive test suite that covers all major task requirements (cartesian products, include/exclude rules, max-parallel, fail-fast, size validation, GitHub Actions integration, and error handling). Well-organized across two test files with clear test names grouped by behavior cycles. Good error scenario coverage (10+ error paths tested) and uses fixtures appropriately. However, limited edge case variety—no tests for special characters or unicode in axis values, limited testing of complex nested object interactions, and no explicit tests for determinism/ordering beyond jq sorts. Integration testing via act-test-harness and workflow structure validation are strong. Would catch most regressions in core functionality but has blind spots in input edge cases and complex rule compositions.
